title: CLCON/128/2018 of Dr. Ravindra Pal Singh Negi Vs Nilesh Jha

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
ON THE 7TH DAY OF SEPTEMBER, 2021
BEFORE:
HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
Contempt Petition No. 128 of 2018
BETWEEN:
Dr. Ravindra Pal Singh Negi ....Petitioner
(There is no representation for the petitioner. )
AND:
Nilesh Jha ...Respondent
(By Mr. J.S. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the respondent)
JUDGMENT
A Division Bench of this Court vide order
dated 01.09.2016 passed in WPSB No. 36 of 2016
had directed the Principal Secretary, Department of
Health, Uttarakhand to convene a Review
Departmental Promotion Committee and consider the
case of the petitioner for promotion on the post of
Joint Director from the date of his juniors were
recommended.
2. A response affidavit has been filed by
Mr. Nitesh Kumar Jha, Secretary, Medical, Health &
Family Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand,
Dehradun. Paragraph no. 5 of the said affidavit is
reproduced below:-
"That in compliance of the order dated
01.09.2016 passed by Hon'ble High Court of
Nainital in W.P. (S/B) No. 36 of 2016, the

2
review DPC was convened on 7.02.2017,
wherein, DPC was apprised with various
orders passed by Hon'ble High Court in
relation to promotion of respondent along
with Rules 2013 and ACR from year 1999-
2000 to year 2008-09 of Dr. Ravinder Pal
Singh Negi were included, the ACR and other
relevant records of Dr. Ravindra Pal Singh
Negi were produced before the Selection
Committee. However, Selection committee
held that:
"after observing the Annual Confidential
Report from year 1999-2000 to year
2008-2009 of Dr. Ravinder Pal Singh
Negi has classified Dr. Ravindra Pal
Singh Negi under Good Category. Due
to lack vacancy for the post of Joint
Director in the Department, presently
the recommendation for promoting
Dr. Ravindra Pal Singh Negi on the post
of Joint Director is not being
recommended. However, in the event
of any vacancy on that post in future,
the promotion of Dr. Negi from his
junior i.e. Dr. Ramesh Chandra Punera,
who has been promoted by the
Government Order dated 18.12.2012 in
the Good category, from that date of
promotion Dr. Ravindra Pal Singh Negi
is recommended to be promoted."
3. From the stand taken in response
affidavit, it is apparent that a Review Departmental
Promotion Committee was convened and petitioner's
claim, for promotion as Joint Director was
considered, therefore, the direction issued by
Division Bench of this Court stands complied with.
4. Accordingly, Contempt Petition is closed.
Contempt notice issued to respondent is hereby
discharged.
(MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, J.) Navin
